headline: Six Fronts Keep the Strategic Line in Motion
war_summary: The latest returns show the battle line still shifting, with the sharpest movement now concentrated in a handful of sectors. Fisherman’s Row has climbed from 36 to 45 ownership events since the previous edition, recording fourteen in the latest two hours; Eidolo, Black Well, and Dankana Post remain its busiest points, while the holdings stand five Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral. Stlican Shelf has risen from 32 to 38 daily events and posted nine in two hours, led overwhelmingly by Breaker Town. Weathered Expanse remains the largest furnace at 62 events, five in the latest two hours, with Frostmarch and Wightwalk accounting for most of the activity; its line is four Warden to five Colonial. Mooring County has advanced from fourteen to sixteen events, including two recent actions, chiefly at The Wind Hills. Callahan’s Passage has eased from thirty to twenty-nine events and is quiet in the latest two hours, though five actions were recorded in six. Marban Hollow is a fresh concern, with four events in two hours at Mox. Elsewhere, most fronts report little or no recent ownership movement.
